mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 66 degrees. Tonight, there is a great chance to spot the International Space Station starting at 7:40 PM, as it travels from the northwest over Middleton toward the northeast near Home Depot.

City news this week includes upcoming chip seal road treatments beginning September 23, which will cause lane closures in areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development site plans on October 5.

It is a busy time for local fun. Today, you can visit the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, the Dane County Farmer's Market, or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, Bike the Barns takes place tomorrow at Badger Prairie County Park.

In our weekly police report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was apprehended following an incident involving a gunshot and a broken window.
Culver's of Verona is open until 10:30 PM today; however, please note that the store is currently closed for remodeling, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
